summary: Regression retest of QuizCompletePage persistence fix. Both PASS and FAIL flows now correctly persist to user_sessions. Pass flow: 10/10 correct -> quiz_completed=true AND quiz_score=10 in Supabase. Fail flow: 2/10 correct -> quiz_score=2 updated AND quiz_completed remains false. Zero console errors during save effect. Pass CTA (Continue to Interview) and Fail CTA (Retry) render correctly. CRITICAL bug from iteration 9 is RESOLVED.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: SessionStartPage phase cards do not expose phase-specific data-testids (e.g., phase-quiz-status). DB state shows quiz_completed=true after pass, and iteration 9 already verified the visual DONE state for the quiz phase, but adding testids like phase-quiz-status=DONE|TODO would make future regression tests of the DONE-flip deterministic.

Saved-guard in QuizCompletePage still uses state flag flipped in finally{} rather than a ref - if React 18 strict-mode / remount fires save() twice before the first finally resolves, both requests could execute. Low risk because PATCH is idempotent and score is deterministic, but a useRef-based lock is safer.
Fail-path update bypasses markPhaseComplete and calls supabase.update directly. Consider routing it through a thin helper so error handling/logging is uniform across both branches.
scoreData should be defensively built via an allowlist to prevent future accidental re-introduction of non-existent columns (root cause of iteration 9 bug).

rca of the issue: Iteration 9 bug (UPDATE rejected by PostgREST because quiz_total/quiz_attempts/quiz_passed columns didn't exist) is fixed. QuizCompletePage.jsx now builds scoreData={quiz_score: N} only; pass branch -> markPhaseComplete(sessionId,'quiz',scoreData) which also flips quiz_completed=true; fail branch -> supabase.from('user_sessions').update({quiz_score:N}).eq('id',sessionId) with no completion flag. Both branches now console.error on failure instead of swallowing. Reproduction confirmed the fix: two back-to-back PATCHes returned 200 with representation showing the expected final values.
